data.one_liner: A Flutter library for ListView and SliverList that adds scroll-to-bottom loading functionality.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a ListView or SliverList to detect when the user scrolls to the bottom and triggers a load more callback. It supports pagination state handling like loading, success, fail, and finish.
use_when: You need infinite scrolling or pagination for a ListView or SliverList.
You want a simple widget wrapper to handle loading more items as the user scrolls.
avoid_when: You are using widgets other than ListView or SliverList.
Not documented for non-list scrollable views.
strengths: Customizable delegate and text builder for loading states.
weaknesses: Only supports ListView and SliverList, other widgets are not supported.
Limited documentation outside of the basic README.
